## Checklist
- [ ] One logical change; Conventional Commit messages.
- [ ] The interface follows the specification (wiki `Technical-Specification`);
      a change to it updates the spec pages and the traceability matrix.
- [ ] No key, token, hostname, port, internal name or real usage figure in the
      diff, an example, a fixture or a log line.
- [ ] Every new setting is typed, validated at startup and documented.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` (once the file exists).

## Evidence
<!-- What you ran and what it printed (the last lines). -->

## Review
A maintainer posts one verdict comment:

```
APPROVE            (or REQUEST CHANGES, with the findings below it)
HEAD: <full sha of the reviewed head>
```

A new push needs a new verdict.
